combo1.title: Black Whirlwind Chain into a Six-Monster Synchro Board
combo1.description: A Black Whirlwind-powered opening that chains Simoon the Poison Wind, Sudri the Phantom Glimmer, and Vata the Emblem of Wandering into a repeating Synchro engine. Nothung the Starlight and Boreastorm the Wicked Wind are Synchro Summoned and sent back to the Graveyard in sequence, using Black Feather Whirlwind and Zephyros the Elite to keep re-fueling the Whirlwind loop and pump out three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon. The line closes with Blackwing Full Armor Master, a second Black-Winged Dragon, and a second Nothung the Starlight rounding out a six-monster board, backed by Twin Shadow and Black Shadow Squall set in the Spell/Trap Zone. Heads-up: this line uses Crossout Designator, which is Forbidden in the TCG, so it isn't legal at TCG events as shown.

combo2.title: Simoon and Sudri Double Summon into Bystial Dis Pater
combo2.description: A Black Whirlwind opening that converts Simoon the Poison Wind and Sudri the Phantom Glimmer into two Normal Summons in the same turn. Simoon banishes Harmattan the Dust from hand to summon itself, Whirlwind searches off every summon, and Shamal the Sandstorm banishes itself to bring out Vata the Emblem of Wandering, which mills Chinook the Snow Blast and Zephyros the Elite for Black-Winged Dragon. Zephyros bounces Sudri back to hand to reuse it, Black-Winged Dragon is recycled into Bystial Dis Pater, and Black Feather Whirlwind revives Zephyros and Sharnga the Waning Moon to Synchro Summon Blackwing - Nothung the Starlight. The board finishes with Dis Pater, Nothung, a re-summoned Sudri and Blackwing - Twin Shadow active in the backrow.

combo3.title: Raptor Wing Strike Engine into Triple Assault Dragon and Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss
combo3.description: An explosive Blackwing line utilizing Raptor Wing Strike to cycle Simoon the Poison Wind back to the Deck while Black Whirlwind fetches Sudri the Phantom Glimmer. Chaining Sudri, Shamal the Sandstorm, and Vata the Emblem of Wandering establishes Black Feather Whirlwind and brings out Black-Winged Dragon. Nothung the Starlight grants an extra Normal Summon for a second Sudri search, while Monster Reborn and Zephyros the Elite assemble Boreastorm the Wicked Wind and Oroshi the Squall to Synchro Summon Hot Red Dragon Archfiend Abyss. The setup cascades into summoning three separate copies of Black-Winged Assault Dragon, before Blackwing - Twin Shadow recycles materials into Blackwing Full Armor Master and adds Chinook the Snow Blast to hand for quick-effect monster negation.
